brief: 5 skincare myths a board-certified specialist wants you to stop believing.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.subtitle: SEPARATING FACT FROM BEAUTY FICTION TODAY

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: THE REAL ROUTINE
slots.body: Not all advice is created equal. Here are the five myths I correct most often in my clinic, so you can care with confidence.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: NATURAL IS ALWAYS BETTER
slots.body: Poison ivy is natural, yet harmful. Synthetic actives like retinoids are clinically proven and precisely formulated for real results without unnecessary irritation.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: OILY SKIN NEEDS NOTHING
slots.body: Every skin type requires hydration. Skipping moisturizer can trigger excess oil production as your skin overcompensates for dehydration, leading to more congestion.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: EXFOLIATE EVERY SINGLE DAY
slots.body: Daily scrubs compromise your barrier. Gentle, spaced exfoliation supports cell turnover while preserving the lipids that keep your complexion calm and resilient.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: TINGLE MEANS IT WORKS
slots.body: Sensation is not efficacy. A gentle formula can deliver powerful actives without inflammation; persistent stinging often signals irritation, not transformation.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: PRICE EQUALS PERFORMANCE
slots.body: Luxury packaging does not guarantee results. What matters is the concentration of proven ingredients matched to your specific skin concerns and goals.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.headline: BOOK YOUR CONSULT
slots.body: Ready for a routine backed by science? Let me create a protocol tailored to your skin.
